description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Drizzt, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Pay {4} for the Nim Deathmantle trigger, returning Drizzt to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Drizzt triggers, creating a legendary Cat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Drizzt triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.
